notes.title: Avatars Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone - we have deployed a new patch for those who have Steam keys to access Samsara for testing purposes. If you wish to play the latest update, you may need to restart Steam for it to pick up the patch.

We are happy to share that there are changes to address the feedback regarding the feel and pacing of combat, as well as to tackle some of the other user feedback we received during the Steam Next Fest in June.

July 2025 - Avatars Update

Unleash unique ultimate powers for all six avatars, powerful abilities that empower you to survive in the deadly world of Kamadhatu.

New boss at the end of Uttarakuru: battle Mara, "the tempter" and his aspects.

New boss at the end of Act 2: face the judgement of Yama, "Lord of Death" in your quest to escape Samsara.

Find a mischievous lost Tiryag in an optional questline found in Uttarakuru: End of an Age, who ponders the significance of the bell which tolls doom.

Changes to Combat pacing, animations and feel.

Additional bug fixes and improvements after player feedback.

Thank you for your continued feedback and bug reports. This update addresses several underlying issues, and we are hard at work on polishing content and fixing said issues. Our team is committed to improving your journey through the Bardo.

We believe in transparency, and we want to continue to engage with our players as and when bugs appear. We appreciate your patience as we work to resolve these bugs. Please continue to report any issues you encounter via the in-game link in the Pause menu.



See you in the Bardo,

☸️  Samsara Team

notes.title: An Important Update on the Release of Samsara
notes.content:
Hello, everyone;

We've made the difficult but necessary decision to delay the full launch of Samsara. This means we will not be releasing on Steam tomorrow, June 17th.

The feedback we received during Steam Next Fest was incredibly valuable. We saw a lot of interest in the game's core hook: the reincarnation system, where death leads you to one of six avatars based on the karma of your choices. However, you also told us that the impact of your actions on your karma wasn't clear, the initial learning experience was steep and confusing, and the onboarding process needed significant work.

Simply put, we agree. Our goal has always been to deliver a challenging but fair souls-like experience, and the current version doesn't properly introduce the very systems that make Samsara unique. Releasing a game that doesn't meet our own standards or your expectations, is not something we're willing to do.

For that reason, we are taking this time to go back and focus on key areas. We will be: overhauling the tutorial to better explain core mechanics such as karma, reincarnation and combat; refining and polishing key aspects such as movement, combat and story; as well as implementing quality-of-life fixes and balance tweaks to bring the game up to your exacting standards.

This will take time. As such, we don't have a new release date to share right now, as our sole focus is on getting it right.

We believe in the vision of Samsara and are committed to realising the game's potential. Thank you for your incredible support and feedback. We'll be keeping you updated on our progress.





Sincerely,

the team @ INFINITY27

notes.title: June 9th Steam Next Fest Demo
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest Demo
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958738/0723b3e46e9cede112e6c8a10fc37b1f95417586.png

The Free Demo of Samsara is ready to go!
The game releases in full 17th June 2025
What's included?
We will be providing a demo of Samsara which includes the following:


 Opening tutorial area, the Rebirth Cave at the world's edge ("Cakravada").
 A full level to explore within the Desire Realm ("Khamadhatu"), Jambudvipa, a tropical continent located south of Mt Meru.
 Face off against the "Asura Lord of Jambudvipa": Lord Matsala, in a multi-phase boss fight that challenges everything you've learnt.
 Engage in an optional questline that impacts the game world: featuring the hedonistic and self-righteous Deva, Suvana.
 Reincarnate as 6 different playable Avatars:

Manusya - Smaller and weaker, but balanced - the only avatar capable of escaping.

Playstyle: Jack of all trades, master of none.

Abilities: Protective gestures to shield, immobilise and contain enemies.

Lore: Symbolic of hope and closest to karmic harmony.

Deva - Those who distinguish themselves with acts of mercy and kindness are reborn as the Deva, who glide lightly through the air and boast a deep well of magical power.

Playstyle: Weaver of magic, with healing and destruction hand in hand.

Abilities: Capable of creating illusions, healing and causing damage with the air element.

Lore: Pristine, deific beings residing in the heavens atop Mt Meru.

Asura - Righteous fury incarnate, the multi-armed Asura grows more powerful as their being diminishes.

Playstyle: Fury personified, overwhelming enemies with their physical strength and elemental magic.

Abilities: Able to summon all five elements to cause damage, buff themselves with invulnerability and debuff enemies' defences.

Lore: Wrathful demi-gods known for their fiery tempers and prowess in battle.

Naraka - Hellish beings wielding fearsome and potent combat abilities that allow them to obliterate foes even at a distance.

Playstyle: The Trickster, armed with dangerous magic that manipulates the battlefield.

Abilities: Wields fire at a distance to engulf, debuff and ensnare, while summoning more of its kind to overwhelm enemies.

Lore: Those who walk a path of violence or ill-will are attuned to and revel in punishment and suffering.

Tiryag - Animalistic with keen instincts that help them sense unseen foes and augment their focus in the heat of battle.

Playstyle: A Hunter with the power to hone their senses to spot danger and become deadlier in combat.

Abilities: Able to astral travel, call on nature, sense enemies through their surroundings and slow time in combat.

Lore: Bestial warriors, fueled by their instincts.

Preta - Their greed requires them to sustain their life at the expense of others but leads them to treasures most would miss.

Playstyle: Avarice manifest, feeding off of enemies and sharing their torment through afflictions.

Abilities: Senses hidden treasures, leeches health, debuffs and damages enemies over time.

Lore: The sorry fate of these beings is to know hunger unending, even in places of abundance.

 Various enemies, weapons, spells, accessories and offhand implements to find throughout your journey.

Where to provide feedback?
We have a Steam Community Discussion which includes a number of ways to get in touch.

When will the demo be removed?
The demo will be available for the duration of Steam Next Fest and for 2 weeks after, the final date it will be available is 2025-06-30.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683570/Samsara/
Consider adding us to your Wishlist as the full version of the game will arrive 2025-06-17
Samsara is available for Early Access purchase NOW on  SamsaraGame.com .

notes.title: The World Cycle Update - Now Live!
notes.content:
The World Progression Update is now LIVE

In this update, players will be able to complete the game and experience the full cycle of Samsara.


 Play through the entire Bardo ("intermediate state") after the moment of death: explore acts 1, 2 and 3 of the game in your quest to Escape Samsara - the endless cycle of death and rebirth into which all life is bound.
 Explore all four continents of Kamadhatu during Act 1, in pursuit of The Three Jewels. Find yourself thrust into the Heavens and Hells, in an expanded rebirth area, which harbours secret areas only accessible in Act 2. Find a way to Escape Samsara before Act 3, when the 49-day cycle obliterates Kamadhatu and the karmic winds of rebirth drag you into the next life.
 New challenge at the end of Aparagodaniya: in pursuit of the enigmatic Kamadhenu, a "wish-granting cow".
 Choose to help a mysterious old woman in an optional questline found in Aparagodaniya: A Voice in the Wind, to unravel the secret behind the endless war raging over the wish-granting cow.
 Track down a mysterious liquid, a source of powerful visions for the Preta outcast, Raksa: in Resplendent Visions, a new questline in Viratdeha.
 Additional bug fixes and improvements after player feedback.

Please note: Save game data will not be compatible with the new version. You will need to enter the settings menu and select to delete save data, else you'll fall through the floor endlessly. 

Gain access to the Early Access version at  samsaragame.com 
Or add to your Wishlist to get the full version once it goes live June 17th!

notes.title: Samsara Update Roadmap
notes.content:
What is included in the Samsara early access?
December 2024 - Early Access release exclusive to the Epic Game Store


 Three continents to explore within the Desire Realm ("Khamadhatu"):

[olist]
Jambudvipa, a tropical continent located south of Mt Meru;
Viratdeha, a jewel-encrusted and snow-bound continent to the east;
Aparagodaniya, a once lush land that has turned to desert, in the west.
[/olist]
 Opening tutorial area, the Rebirth Cave at the world's edge ("Cakravada").
 Face off against the "Asura Lord of Jambudvipa": Lord Matsala, in a multi-phase boss fight that challenges everything you've learnt.
 Engage an optional questline in Jambudvipa that impacts the game world: Matsala's Folly, featuring the hedonistic and self-righteous Deva, Suvana.
 Reincarnate as 6 different playable Avatars:

[olist]
Asura - Anger - Wrathful demi-gods known for their fiery tempers and prowess in battle. Imposing and impassioned. Righteous fury incarnate, the multi-armed Asura grows more powerful as their being diminishes.
Deva - Rapture - Pristine, deific beings residing in the heavens atop Mt Meru. Those who distinguish themselves with acts of mercy and kindness are reborn as the Deva, who glide lightly through the air and boast a deep well of magical power.
Tiryag - Animality - Bestial warriors, fuelled by their instincts. Using their finely honed animal instincts for survival helps them sense unseen foes. Their heightened senses slow their perception of time in conflict, at the cost of being blinded by their single-minded mental state of stupidity and prejudice.
Preta - Hunger - A hungry ghost. Avarice manifest. A sorry fate. Forever hungry, even in places of abundance. Their being is gradually drained as their hunger is never truly sated. Their greed requires them to sustain their life at the expense of others, and they find treasures most would miss.
Manusya - Desire, doubt, passion, pride and above all hope - Symbolic of hope and closest to karmic harmony. To be a human is to stand at the hub of fate’s wheel. Those whose karma has not yet pulled them far from where they began will take on this balanced form.
Naraka - Hell - Vindictive, devious punishers. Those who walk a path of violence or ill-will are attuned to and revel in punishment and suffering. Hellish beings wielding fearsome and potent combat abilities that allow them to obliterate foes even at a distance.
[/olist]
Various enemies, weapons, spells, accessories and offhand implements to find throughout your journey.


What is the roadmap for Samsara updates?
February 2025 - Uttarakuru Update

Fourth continent: Uttarakuru, in the North of Khamadhatu.
New boss at the end of Viratdeha: Khyati, the fallen but proud Deva.
Revamped Meditation Menu.
Improvements to the Exploration systems.
New enemies, weapons, spells, accessories and offhand implements.


April 2025 - World Progression Update

New boss at the end of Aparagodaniya: fought in pursuit of the enigmatic Kamadhenu, a "wish-granting cow".
Improvements to the Combat systems.
Additional content TBC.


June 2025 - Samsara: Rebirth Release

1.0 release on Steam and Epic Games Store.
Face the "Lord of Death": Yama, the embodiment of impermanence and judge of ones past life and actions.
Experience additional questlines and complete the story ("Escape Samsara") in the final update to the base game.
Improvements to the Discourse systems.
PROTOGÉ Mode added: see contributions from aspiring game developers who trained at INFINITY27, an Unreal Authorised Training Center.


Are there any post-release updates planned?
Yes. We have plans to continue to support the game with content updates but we wish to share them closer to the 1.0 release date. Games take time and we don't wish to overpromise at this stage.

notes.title: Closed Playtest Invite
notes.content:
📣 Attention avatar, you are invited to join the closed playtests for SAMSARA ☸️

Closed Playtests
Our team has been working to address the feedback you provided during the open playtest over the summer so that we can focus on improving the experience and game feel. Our aim is to deliver a scheduled playtest build, with iterations and additions to the core gameplay and content.

Playtest Info
This weekend we will be running the first of our scheduled playtests, which we invite you to join. The purpose is to get the close feedback of a smaller group of players, with whom the development team can communicate directly. If this interests you and you would like to get involved, please join our Discord and let us know in the #samsara chat.

As with the pre-alpha playtest over the summer, the purpose of these tests is to gauge your reactions to the game and the changes we're making each month. Please be aware that closed testing will be on the current build of the game. This means that there will be known performance issues, bugs and missing features. You won’t need to worry about making bug reports; the focus of the tests will be gathering feedback on several key parts of the experience, such as the appeal of the themes, mechanics and gameplay feel. We’re looking for your honest opinions, so that your voice can be instrumental in sculpting SAMSARA into a quality experience.

We are a small studio that is committed to creating the best game possible from our vision with your input. Therefore, we appreciate the help that your time and opinions give us as we work towards our goals.

Future Playtests
Enrolment
Entry to an individual playtest will enrol you into the #samsara-playtest channel on Discord. If you wish to stop hearing from us, simply leave/mute updates from that channel. You are of course welcome to re-join future playtests by asking again in the #samsara chat.

Schedule

 FRI-30-SEP until SUN-2-OCT
 FRI-9-DEC until SUN-11-DEC
 FRI-24-FEB until SUN-26-FEB
 FRI-21-APR until SUN-23-APR 
 ...more dates may be announced for 2023.

Tests are live over the final weekend of each month. They should start no later than 6 PM (UK) on the Friday and end by 9 AM (UK) on the Monday. However, these are a guide only and actual times may vary. Notices will be pushed in the #samsara-playtesters channel on our Discord when the playtest goes live.

notes.title: Closed Pre-Alpha Available Now
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296187/2522ad0290ad56fbd889f60d3ac7aba1cd79b9c1.png

🎉 Welcome avatar, to the closed pre-alpha for SAMSARA ☸️

Foreword
Your time and input are valuable to us so we can create the best game possible.

The focus of this pre-alpha test is to gauge how audiences react to the game itself. Please be aware that there are known performance issues, bugs and missing features but that the focus of the test is on the appeal of the themes and gameplay. Therefore, don't worry about making bug reports - just give us your honest opinions on the visuals and feel of the gameplay.

You can find our playtest feedback form here: https://forms.gle/fwS5omyXiJ9VTmh77

Furthermore, if you're a Soulsborne/Souls-like fan we would very much appreciate to get your detailed input on what you like about these types of games (souls-like's) so we can ensure we're appealing to your tastes.

Our in-depth Soulsborne Survey can be found here: https://forms.gle/xw5DnD7BTdbXEUWVA

What to Expect
Be aware that the game is not fit for consumers at present. Features and quality are not representative of the final product. This means that most of the avatars, levels, systems and content is absent. However, we do feel there is enough to start getting valuable player feedback.

What is currently available for testing:

 One sub-continent (level); Cakravada - the edge of the world.
 Three playable avatars; Deva, Naraka and Manusya.
 Basic combat, avatar skills, dialogue and questing.

Character and environment models (i.e. visuals) are a work-in-progress and the character renders used here are indicative of the level of quality we're aiming for in the graphics and fidelity is something we're striving for in the visuals. Performance is of course a priority but only moderate optimisations have been able to be implemented at present. You are likely to encounter performance issues, especially on low-end hardware. The demo will auto-detect and apply graphics settings based on a benchmark that runs as you open the game to alleviate this.

Our hope is that we can gather your feedback on an early version of the game so we can align our team on the most valuable gameplay experience. That said, we are not a huge studio and there is no NDA. We are a small, scrappy studio looking to reach our audience, so please do let your friends know about SAMSARA :-)

How to Access
Please follow these instructions for accessing the PC test via Steam:

1. Visit the SAMSARA Steam Page
Visit our steam page...
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683570/Sasra/

2. Download & Install
Select 'Add to Wishlist' and then 'Request Access' as shown below. The title should appear available to download in your Steam Library after access is granted by our team.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296187/497dfb01f6c3d0b80abbc4fd9f043323bf08ee9c.png

3. Play & Provide Feedback
Play the game from your Steam library and don't forget to provide feedback.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296187/8c1f899e55f3c8428799daa3d3bdc592d08f583d.png

Wishlist & Follow
If you are interested in accessing further tests or the final game then please add our game to your Wishlist on Steam and join our Discord channel or mailing list to be the first to get updates and invites to future events and demos.

You can also follow our development over on Twitter and Youtube.
 

Love & Respect,
from the team @ I N F I N I T Y 27
